Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["docx"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:google-workspace","description":"Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. Structure is enforced by the parsers instead:\n13\t     tools/gates/finding-registry.ts and tools/gates/commit-msg-validator.ts. -->\n14\t\n15\t# Tenant Configuration & Provisioning Settings — findings\n16\t\n17\t> Part of [Admin Panel E2E Audit](../README.md). IDs `APA-xxx` are stable; severity shown is the\n18\t> verified severity where status is CONFIRMED, else the auditor's grade pending verification.\n19\t\n20\t## TenantConfigurationPage — `/admin/tenants/:tenantId/configuration` — verdict: **MOCK_ONLY**\n21\t\n22\t**Chain:** Routing and auth verified working: FE tenantConfigApi\n23\t(web/modules/admin-panel/src/services/api/tenant-config.ts) hits '/api/settings/tenant/:tenantId/_',\n24\tnginx rewrites ^/api/(._) to /api/v1/$1 (infrastructure/nginx/droplet.conf:382), matching\n25\tadmin-api's global prefix 'api/v1' (libs/backend-common/src/bootstrap/create-service-app.ts:610) +\n26\tTenantConfigurationController @Controller('settings/tenant')\n27\t(apps/admin-api-service/src/settings/controllers/tenant-configuration.controller.ts:42); all\n28\trequests pass the global PlatformAdminGuard (RS256 JWT + SUPER_ADMIN,\n29\tapps/admin-api-service/src/app.module.ts:283-290, guards/platform-admin.guard.ts:59,155-177). Moot while the endpoints 410, but a latent validation gap if\n  restored.\n- **Evidence:**\n  - `apps/admin-api-service/src/settings/controllers/tenant-configuration.controller.ts:18-26`\n  - `apps/admin-api-service/src/settings/services/tenant-configuration.service.ts:46-51`\n  - `web/modules/admin-panel/src/services/api/tenant-config.ts:263-271`\n- **Root cause:** createConfiguration, updateConfiguration, createApiKey, createWebhook,\n  initiateCustomDomainVerification and updateBranding type their @Body() as\n  CreateTenantConfigurationDto/UpdateTenantConfigurationDto/CreateApiKeyDto/CreateWebhookDto/VerifyDomainDto/UpdateBrandingDto\n  — all plain `export interface`s in tenant-configuration.service.ts. Systemic class:\n  unvalidated interface-DTO.
